title: Admin and quest charts draw in the accent color again, not in ink

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-21: most graphs lost their color.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-21. PREMISE RE-TESTED: under the Frequency design --color-primary resolves to --fq-action-primary, which is ink (--fq-text-strong), so every chart that painted with fill-primary or stroke-primary rendered grey and black. Member growth, events a week, practice library, verified practices and Vera questions all read as grey. The charts now paint with --color-primary-strong, which resolves to the accent (--fq-accent). Covers spark-charts (TrendArea, WeekBars, RingGauge), the journey progress ring and the quest season map arc. Buttons and stars keep ink on purpose.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('components/admin/spark-charts.tsx','utf8');if(/(fill|stroke)-primary(?![-\w])/.test(s)){console.error('LIVE-1196: a chart paints with ink (primary) instead of the accent');process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when a spark chart goes back to fill-primary or stroke-primary, which is ink under the Frequency design.
